title: Dualcaster Mage creates a real Opt spell copy without casting it
plain_english: P0 casts the real frozen-Oracle Opt and leaves it on the stack.
P0 casts the real frozen-Oracle Dualcaster Mage while Opt remains a legal instant target.
After Dualcaster Mage resolves, its enters-the-battlefield trigger is put on the stack with Opt as the recorded target.
The trigger resolves and creates a synthetic spell-copy object with no physical-card component and was_cast set to false.
The copied Opt resolves through the same production stack path and then ceases to exist after its recorded zone arrival.

preconditions: Opt is a spell object on the stack
Dualcaster Mage is a physical card in P0 hand
the trigger target choice records the current Opt object ID
ordered_operations: all players pass to resolve Dualcaster Mage
all players pass to resolve Dualcaster Mage ETB trigger
all players pass to resolve copied Opt
required_assertions: the spell copy is retired and ceased_to_exist after resolution
